experiences.title: Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics & Telecommunication
experiences.description: Electronics engineering student focusing on embedded systems, RTOS, and hardware–software co-design.
experiences.fullDescription:
Currently pursuing a Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics & Telecommunication. My academic focus includes embedded systems, microcontroller programming, real-time operating systems, and low-level hardware–software integration.

I actively build hands-on projects involving ESP32 systems, FreeRTOS-based firmware, PCB design, and system-level programming to understand how software interacts with hardware.
highlights: Strong focus on embedded systems and RTOS

experiences.title: Software Head
experiences.description: Led development of the college tech-fest platform and backend infrastructure.
experiences.fullDescription:
As Software Head of the V Clubs Committee, I managed the development of the college tech-fest platform. I designed REST APIs, implemented authentication systems, and coordinated a team of developers to build and deploy the platform.

This role strengthened my experience in system design, backend architecture, and team collaboration.
